technique_name: Generate an essay on the following topic
description:
Technology has had a profound impact on society and has changed the way we live our lives. From the way we communicate to the way we interact with our surroundings, technology has pushed almost every aspect of life to evolve in recent years.

The introduction of smartphones has revolutionized the way we stay connected, with many people glued to their devices for hours a day. Social media has brought people together from all over the world and enabled connections that wouldn’t have been possible
example: The impact of technology on society
